solar-autoresearch: 3cc7b64b
A participant experiment with saved code, predictions, and research-agent traces.
Anish Shah
Last updated: November 13, 2026
What I tested
On 199 overlapping image windows from February 13–14, 2014, final disk-masked error was persistence: 0.125762, manual: 0.122442, agent: 0.120769. The agent-selected masked-L1 model reduced error by 1.37% relative to the manual residual predictor in this single rehearsal. Round two tried cosine learning-rate decay, regressed on validation, and retained the previous source. Forecasting weights were trained; the research-agent model stayed fixed. The short GOES training budget was insufficient: the selected measurement model scored 2.469 log-flux MAE versus 0.193 for persistence. These are separate tasks, not one combined score. Two test days and one seed do not establish solar forecasting performance. Measured inference cost was $0.02708366. Native EvalTables returned HTTP 500. Saved Weave evaluations, W&B tables and local predictions remain available. Publication retries do not repeat training or inference. The complete code, data contract and qualification limits are in https://github.com/ash0ts/forge-workshop-kit.
